        else:
            winner = 'B'
            excess_votes_A = max(0, district_votes_A[d] - (majority - district_votes_B[d]))
            wasted_votes_A += excess_votes_A
            wasted_votes_B += district_votes_B[d]
            results.append(f"{winner} {excess_votes_A} {district_votes_B[d]}")

    # Calculate the efficiency gap
    efficiency_gap = abs(wasted_votes_A - wasted_votes_B) / (total_votes_A + total_votes_B)

    # Output the results for each district
    for result in results:
        print(result)

    # Output the efficiency gap
    print(f"{efficiency_gap:.10f}")
